notes.title: ❄️Edge of Collapse devlog #1❄️
notes.content:
[b]Hello [h2]Edge of Collapse[/h2] funs[/b]
We'd like to give you a little bit of information about the development of our game.

At the moment the game is already in the stage of the demo version in which you will be able to play soon.... 😉for sure some of you have already guessed when🤫, but we will announce it with a separate news item

The game is based on Kyla Stone's book series "Edge of Collapse" and has a strong plot line, telling the story of main character Hannah's 👩 ordeal, escape, breaking barriers and building a friendship with her faithful companion Ghost🐕[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42847567/e615b104007aaf60c3c1df648f4336bba83810ba.jpg[/img]

[b]
What was happend? [/b]

During one of Michigan's cold winters, an EMP attack occurs💣, causing a power outage 🔌🔦. Cars🚗, phones📵, and other amenities are out of service. It is this event that allows Hanna to get out of her tormentor's basement
 

[b]Tactical Turn Based Fight[/b]
Avoid danger by sneaking behind enemy's backs or face them in turn-based battles. Use the terrain to your advantage and utilise each character's abilities.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42847567/a95f3420e9231d4e8396fed2dfb040d3a4a83f94.jpg[/img]


[b]Story[/b]
Thanks to the EMP, Hannah Sheridan imprisoned for the past five years in a psychopath's basement can finally get out. At the edge of her mental and physical endurance and pregnant, Hannah tries to make her way through miles of freezing forest. She is determined to reach her family.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42847567/94beda941b25b5c01ade134a3615704da86a53a6.jpg[/img]

[b]Team and Skills[/b]
Each character has unique abilities to solve different environmental puzzles. The player will have to combine them in a clever way to survive in a hostile world.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42847567/8ac16cbc58e6cd457881173b76a2a84e9684508e.jpg[/img]
